xctrackGridFormula.cellSizePxFormula: max(8.0f, 0.11952191f * densityDpi)  // where 0.11952191f = 3.0f / 25.1f (~3mm physical grid cell)

devices.name: AIR³ 7.2
devices.notes: Dedicated 7-inch Android flight computer pre-configured with XCTrack Pro. Typically mounted in landscape on cockpit.

devices.name: AIR³ 7.3 / 7.3+
devices.notes: Upgraded FHD+ (1920×1200, 16:10) display; 7.3+ adds internal FLARM/Fanet+ module and high-precision barometer.

devices.name: AIR³ 7.35 / 7.35+
devices.notes: Ultra-bright 2200–2600 nits panel for direct high-altitude sunlight visibility; pre-loaded with custom AIR³ XCTrack profiles.

devices.name: Naviter Oudie N / Fanet+
devices.notes: Android-based dedicated flight instrument; while running SeeYou Navigator natively, pilots also install XCTrack on it.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab Active3
devices.notes: Very popular 8-inch rugged cockpit tablet with physical navigation keys (Back/Home/Recents) usable with flight gloves and S-Pen.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab Active4 Pro
devices.notes: Large 10.1-inch rugged tablet for spacious competition cockpits.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab Active5
devices.notes: 2024 successor to Tab Active3 with 120Hz outdoor-boosted display, physical hardware buttons, and No-Battery Mode.

devices.name: Tripltek 7 Pro
devices.notes: 1200-nit sustained high-brightness rugged 7-inch tablet popular with drone and paragliding pilots.

devices.name: Tripltek 8 Pro
devices.notes: 8-inch 2560×1600 (16:10) 1200-nit sustained display with 12,200 mAh battery.

devices.name: Tripltek 9 Pro
devices.notes: 8-inch active viewing area at 2560×1600 (16:10) with 1300 nits sustained brightness.

devices.name: Blackview BV6900
devices.notes: Frequently seen in XCTrackLayoutEditor community configs (19×36 portrait grid with nav/status bars, 19×38 fullscreen).

devices.name: Blackview BV8800 / BV9900 / BL8800
devices.notes: High-capacity battery rugged phone with barometer and customizable physical side keys for XCTrack zoom/page switching.

devices.name: Ulefone Armor 3 / 3T / 3WT
devices.notes: Listed on xctrack.org/Devices.html (14h30m max brightness benchmark); 10,300 mAh battery + built-in walkie-talkie on 3T/3WT.

devices.name: Ulefone Armor 18 / 24 / 26 Ultra
devices.notes: Modern big-battery rugged Ulefone Armor series (9600 mAh to 22000 mAh) with barometric sensor and hardware PTT/custom keys.

devices.name: Crosscall Core-Z5 / Action-X5 / Trekker-X4
devices.notes: French rugged outdoor phone brand popular among European hike-and-fly pilots; features programmable hardware buttons.

devices.name: UMIDIGI Bison X10
devices.notes: Listed on xctrack.org/Devices.html (12h01m max brightness test): internal barometer and 2 programmable hardware buttons.

devices.name: Google Pixel 6
devices.notes: Appears in XCTrackLayoutEditor community configs. Stock 420 dpi gives 22×48 fullscreen grid; custom Display Size (+1 step, 480 dpi) gives 19 cols.

devices.name: Google Pixel 6 Pro
devices.notes: User's previous flight phone! Native 1440×3120 @ 560 dpi (411×891 dp). Fullscreen grid is 22×47; with Android 13 status/nav bar insets it exported as 22×43.

devices.name: Google Pixel 7 / Pixel 8
devices.notes: Pixel 7 (6.3", 1400 nits) and Pixel 8 (6.2", 2000 nits peak) share 1080×2400 @ 420 dpi (411×914 dp, 22×48 fullscreen grid).

devices.name: Google Pixel 8 Pro
devices.notes: User's primary flight phone! Logical viewport is 448×997 dp in both Full Res (1344×2992 @ 480 dpi) and High Res (1008×2244 @ 360 dpi). Produces exact 23×52 grid in fullscreen (Android 16 backup) and 23×48 grid with system bar insets (Android 14 pages export).

devices.name: Google Pixel 9 / Pixel 9 Pro / 9a
devices.notes: Pixel 9 Pro is benchmarked on xctrack.org/Devices.html (13h06m runtime) with 3000 nits peak brightness. Pixel 9 & 9a (1080×2424 @ 420 dpi) use 22×48 grid; Pixel 9 Pro (1280×2856 @ 480 dpi, 427×952 dp) uses 22×50 grid.

devices.name: Google Pixel 9 Pro XL / 10 Pro XL
devices.notes: Shares the exact 1344×2992 @ 480 dpi (448×997 dp) resolution and 23×52 XCTrack grid with the Pixel 8 Pro, with 3000 nits peak brightness.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy A51 / A52 / A53
devices.notes: The default preset in XCTrackLayoutEditor ('Samsung A51 1080×2400', 22×44 grid with system bar insets, 22×48 fullscreen).

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy A35 / A54 / A55 5G
devices.notes: The most common device family in XCTrackLayoutEditor community library (10+ configs)! Uses 450 dpi (384×832 dp), yielding a 20×44 portrait / 44×20 landscape grid.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy S21 / S21+ 5G (SM-G991B)
devices.notes: Appears in XCTrackLayoutEditor community configs (22×42 portrait with insets, 22×48 fullscreen; or 19×38 when OneUI screen zoom is increased to 480 dpi).

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy S22 / S23 / S24 / S25 (Base & Plus, FHD+)
devices.notes: S22/S23/S24/S25 base and Plus models (in default FHD+ mode) use 1080×2340 (19.5:9). At OneUI default 450 dpi (384×832 dp) they produce a 20×44 grid; at 420 dpi (411×891 dp) they produce a 22×47 grid.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy S22 / S23 / S24 / S25 Ultra (QHD+)
devices.notes: Highly prized by XC pilots for S24/S25 Ultra's Gorilla Armor anti-reflective coating and 2600-nit brightness. Note: S24/S25 Ultra is 1440×3120 (19.5:9) while S22/S23 Ultra is 1440×3088 (19.3:9). Default OneUI density (384×823 dp, 600 dpi in QHD+ or 450 dpi in FHD+) yields 20×43/44 grid; with Minimum Width set to 411 dp (560 dpi) it yields 22×46/47.

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy M31s / M51 (Big-Battery Series)
devices.notes: Famous on xctrack.org/Devices.html for 22–26 hours of continuous XCTrack battery life (6000–7000 mAh battery + AMOLED black theme).

devices.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 / Z Fold 6 (Unfolded Main Screen)
devices.notes: Near-square unfolded tablet canvas (1856×2160 on Fold6, 1812×2176 on Fold5), ideal for side-by-side XC Assistant + Thermal Assistant + Competition Map.

devices.name: Google Pixel 9 Pro Fold (Unfolded Main Screen)
devices.notes: 8-inch nearly 1:1 square OLED display (2076×2152) with 2700 nits peak brightness.

devices.name: Xiaomi Redmi Note 11 / 12 / 13 Pro & POCO X5 / X6
devices.notes: Redmi Note 11 is benchmarked on xctrack.org/Devices.html at 17h40m runtime. MIUI/HyperOS uses 440 dpi (392.7×872.7 dp) on 1080×2400 screens, giving a 21×46 fullscreen grid.

devices.name: Xiaomi 13T / 14T / POCO X6 Pro / F6 (1.5K CrystalRes)
devices.notes: High-brightness (2600–4000 nits peak) 1.5K 1220×2712 panel @ 480 dpi (407×904 dp), yielding a 21×47 fullscreen grid.

devices.name: Motorola Moto G54 / G56 / G84 5G
devices.notes: Appears in XCTrackLayoutEditor community configs ('motorola moto g56 5G 15') with a 23×51 portrait / 51×23 landscape grid (390 dpi).

devices.name: OnePlus 11 / 12 / 13 (QHD+)
devices.notes: Ultra-bright LTPO AMOLED with Aqua Touch (wet touch support for flying in clouds/rain).

devices.name: Sony Xperia 1 V / 5 V / 10 VI (21:9 CinemaWide)
devices.notes: Ultra-tall 21:9 aspect ratio (20×48 grid), giving extra vertical/horizontal space for side-by-side map + instruments.

devices.name: Standard 16:9 Phone / XCTrack Built-in Default Template
devices.notes: XCTrack's built-in raw templates (layout_xcassistant_*, layout_competition_*, layout_thermalassistant_*) use 19×31 (portrait with system bars) and 33×19 (landscape fullscreen), corresponding to 360×640 dp (1080×1920 @ 480 dpi).

devices.name: Hisense A5 / A5 Pro
devices.notes: Benchmarked on xctrack.org/Devices.html at 16h30m runtime. Built-in GPS; use XCTrack 'White (eInk)' theme (WhiteEInkTheme) with North-up non-rotating map.

devices.name: Hisense A7
devices.notes: Large 6.7-inch 300 PPI E-Ink smartphone with internal GPS and 5G.

devices.name: Hisense A9 / Onyx Boox Palma / Palma 2
devices.notes: Both Hisense A9 (6.1") and Onyx Boox Palma/Palma 2 (6.13") share the exact same 824×1648 (2:1) 300 PPI E Ink Carta 1200 panel. Note: Boox Palma has no internal GPS (requires Bluetooth vario/GPS like XC Tracer or SkyDrop).

devices.name: Onyx Boox Poke 2 / 3 / 4 / 5
devices.notes: Listed on xctrack.org/Devices.html (16h45m runtime with external BT GPS/vario). Compact 4:3 e-reader form factor.

devices.name: Onyx Boox Page / Leaf 2 / Go Color 7
devices.notes: 7-inch 4:3 E-Ink tablet with physical page-turn buttons that can be bound to XCTrack actions.

devices.name: inkBOOK Focus / Focus Plus / Focus Color (7.8")
devices.notes: 7.8-inch 4:3 E-Ink reader (also shared with Onyx Boox Nova Air / Tab Mini C at 1404×1872).

hudDevices.name: ActiveLook HUD Glasses (ENGO 1 / ENGO 2 / Julbo EVAD-1)
hudDevices.notes: Uses integer grid coordinates x=0..12, y=0..12 (21×17 px per cell inside 252×204 active area) in active_look_default_layout.json.

hudDevices.name: Everysight Maverick HUD Glasses
hudDevices.notes: Uses integer grid coordinates x=0..25, y=0..12 in maverick_default_layout.json.
